svg.title: Digital pedal: front panel
svg.desc: Seven 10 kilohm linear pots: one outer pin to 3V3, the other to ground, the wiper to ESP32-S3 GPIO 1 to 7, each wiper with a 100 nanofarad capacitor to ground. RV7 pull switch to GPIO18. Footswitches SW1, SW2, SW3 to GPIO15, 16, 17, switching to ground with internal pull-ups. LEDs on GPIO8, 9, 21 through 1 kilohm resistors.
svg.text: Pots: 10k linear (B) on GPIO1-7 (ADC1, works with the radio on). Switches close to GND (internal pull-ups).
